[[File:Skeletal hand icon.png|left]]
'''Skeletal hands''' are [[Slayer monsters]] found in the [[Meiyerditch tunnels]], together with [[mutated bloodveld]] and [[zombie hand]]s. They require level 5 [[Slayer]] to kill. Even though it's not aggressive by itself, at any time when players are in the dungeon, one might fall from the ceiling or crawl from underground and start attacking you. The Meiyerditch tunnels can only be accessed during and after [[Legacy of Seergaze]].

Skeletal hands may be killed to complete [[Crawling hands (Slayer assignment)|crawling hands]], [[Skeletons (Slayer assignment)|skeletons]], and [[Undead (Slayer assignment)|undead Slayer assignment]]. Attacking skeletal hands will occasionally cause skeletal hands hanging from ceiling or buried in the ground to appear and attack you.

Players should use a [[Mask of Broken Fingers]] (or its helm variant [[Helm of the Dead Hand]]) to kill these, especially when on a slayer assignment, to take advantage of its benefits.

Players can obtain a soul of a crawling hand for the [[Slayer Codex]] from this creature when using an [[ushabti]].

==Trivia==
* This monster may drop from the ceiling or emerge from the floor, à la wallmasters/floormasters from the {{Wp|The Legend of Zelda (series)|The Legend of Zelda series}}.
* Despite having no flesh, they can still drop corpses.
